adversarial_reasoning.basis: Read the complete task and complete 354-line current report. Challenged the central inference that more compute helps only through candidate availability, reliable selection, repair or new information. Checked retained original TTC001 sections 3.2 and 5.3 (lines 100-107,150-174), TTC008 section 3 (252-295), and TTC010 section 4.1 (210-224). These originals support the report's explicit separation of oracle coverage from delivered success, exclusion of difficulty-estimation overhead from the fourfold result, conditional candidate independence, and verifier saturation. Checked the hypothetical allocation formula, false-acceptance ceiling, loss-based reversal, scheduler assumptions and deadline example against their declared restricted configurations; they are illustrative rather than empirical or general optimality claims. The report retains selection effects, ground-truth access, training changes, finite-probe optimism, weak tests and irreversible-action counterexamples where they alter the argument. Its design recommendations remain conditional and do not require unavailable online truth. No necessary adversarial-reasoning defect found.
